purpose: Dated owner source-use decisions that the adapters and the public rights projection read. A series or reading gated on a decision is public only while its decision is present here with redistribution_status allowed.

decisions.decided_by: Mrinal, owner of Seiche and LiquiLens Private Limited
decisions.owner_words: go with them all just make sure everything starts working
decisions.question: Whether the Federal Reserve Board's commercial paper rates, which the Board derives from data supplied by The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), fall within the Board's public-domain notice and may be served.
decisions.decision: Fed CP rates may be served. The DTCC origin of the Board's computation is accepted.
conditions: Serve only the Board-published 90-day AA financial and nonfinancial rates from the CP release XML zip, never the underlying DTCC trade records.
Cite the Board as the source and state that the Board derives the release from data supplied by DTCC.
decisions.attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), Commercial Paper release, derived by the Board from data supplied by The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC).

decisions.question: Whether to accept the BLS Public Data API Terms of Service (the mandatory statement and the indemnity for non-government users) so the CPI series can be read through the BLS API.
decisions.decision: BLS series are read through the BLS API and its Terms of Service are accepted.
conditions: Use only the keyless v1 Public Data API within its published limits; no registration key.
Carry the statement the Terms of Service require on every served copy: BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov.
Cite the Bureau of Labor Statistics as the source.
decisions.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
decisions.required_statement: BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov.

decisions.question: Whether serving Bank of Japan total assets on Seiche's free site falls within the Bank of Japan notice, which excludes copying or reproduction for commercial purposes.
decisions.decision: Bank of Japan total assets may be served on the free, no-paywall site.
conditions: Serve only on Seiche's free, no-paywall public surfaces; never through a paid or metered surface.
Credit the Bank of Japan explicitly as the source.
decisions.attribution: Source: Bank of Japan, Time-Series Data Search (BS01, MABJMTA).

decisions.question: Whether to serve raw SONIA from the Bank of England Database under the UK Open Government Licence, instead of derived readings only.
decisions.decision: SONIA is served raw under the Bank of England's open licence, with its attribution.
conditions: Use the Database copy, available by 10:00 London time on the business day after first publication; no real-time benchmark feed.
Carry the Bank's SONIA attribution and the Open Government Licence v3.0 link on every served value.
decisions.attribution: SONIA and/or SONIA Compounded Index data licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and copyright the Governor and Company of the Bank of England.
